profile.name: Pivot Point Performance
profile.description:
Pivot Point Performance is a horse-and-rider wellness company dedicated to helping both ends of the partnership move, feel, and perform at their best.

We specialize in a whole-body, whole-system approach—combining physical therapy, assisted stretching, rider evaluations, and equine bodywork to identify and address the root causes of pain, restriction, or performance limitations.

Whether you’re a competitive athlete, weekend rider, or simply want you and your horse to feel better, our goal is to create better communication, improved movement, and longer-lasting soundness for both horse and rider.

Through hands-on sessions, customized programs, and educational clinics, we don’t just treat symptoms—we give you the tools and understanding to take control of your progress.

Because when both horse and rider move better… everything changes.

pages.excerpt:
HomeAbout BeckyServices CoursesRider MembershipClinicsFind a PractitionerFAQsContactBecome a PractitionerBook With BeckyBook With BeckyHomeAbout Becky//AboutMeet Becky PearsonA physical therapist, horsewoman, WPRA card holder, and founder of Pivot Point Performance — helping riders and horses move better, recover smarter, and stay in the work they love.Join Our Free CommunityBook With BeckyA Horsewoman FirstBecky grew up in rural Minnesota with a crazy passion for horses.Her early years were filled with 4-H, riding, competing, and learning everything she could about horses. She wanted to train horses for a living, but like a lot of young people with a big dream, she was told she needed to get a “real job.”So Becky became a physical therapist assistant and later went on to become a physical therapist.But the horses never left.Over the years, Becky began bringing her physical therapy training into the world she knew best. She started looking at riders and horses through the same lens: movement, mobility, compensation, recovery, performance, and longevity.That process became a method. That method became the Pivot Point Stretch Method and, ultimately, Pivot Point Performance.And today, it has grown beyond Becky herself. Becky now certifies practitioners in the Pivot Point Stretch Method so more people can bring this work to riders, horses, and communities across the country.There is an entire country of people who need this work — and building a network of trained practitioners is how Pivot Point Performance begins to reach them.Becky is a WPRA card holder who has competed in barrel racing at both the professional and local levels. Her daughters, Emma and Gracie, have successfully competed in barrel racing, pole bending, and cutting. Staying in the saddle isn't a hobby for this family — it's a part of their soul.The Turning PointThe Pain That Changed EverythingWhich is why what happened next changed everything: Becky found herself in so much pain, she considered selling her horses.As a physical therapist, she went to work on the problem the way she treats her patients — and she found her way back. Back to riding, back to competing, back to the life she almost gave up. And she realized something at every rodeo and clinic since: almost everyone is hurting. The riders, and just as often, their horses.Why Pivot Point Performance ExistsThat's what Pivot Point Perform

pages.excerpt: This site is powered by course builder. Create your online course today. Start now Create your course with Login Sign Up When you are healthy and painfree, you can achieve whatever your mind can conceive. Pivot Point Equine and Rider Rehab is designed to help the horse and rider perform at their very best, by sharing our years of experience using physical therapy techniques for people and horses.We designed these courses because we know we cannot physically help every horse and rider out there that needs it. We want to educate riders around the globe about what they can do to keep themselves healthy, free of pain and strong to stay solid in the saddle. We're just getting started, so stay tuned to see what classes we have coming up next!The techniques and exercises in this course will take you step by step through the process Becky uses daily to treat two and four legged patients with back pain, poor conditioning, and poor posture to achieve optimal health and wellness. Our Featured CoursesThese courses are designed specifically with horse and rider in mind. They aren't complicated. They aren't lengthy. But they do work! EXAMPLE Course Name Course description Author Name $XXX Coaching Name Coaching description Author Name $XXX Bundle Name Bundle description Courses: x Coaching: x Digital downloads: x $XXX View All Products A little bit about Becky... Becky grew up on a horse, with her early days competing in 4-H in all events, as well as starting her own colts. As her she finished her Masters degree in Physical Therapy and her college years drew to a close, she found herself in the ranch country of the Sandhills of Nebraska. It is here where she started barrel racing and met her husband Chris who is a PRCA steer roper. Becky is a WPRA card holder and competes in barrel racing at both the professional and local levels. Their two daughters, Emma and Gracie, also compete at the high school and junior high levels of rodeo, in barrel racing, pole bending, cutting, and goat tying. Becky and her family understand the need to stay in the saddle, and the importance of being fit to compete at your best.
